summary.text: Karen Burnett-Kurie is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

An education administrator and environmental educator who ran for the House in Carroll 6 in 2024, she said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that she has worked for a range of New Hampshire educational and nonprofit organizations.

paragraphs.text: Burnett-Kurie was born in Pensacola, Florida, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire and a graduate degree from Antioch New England Graduate School, and her career experience includes working in education administration.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said her undergraduate degree is in education and her master's degree is in environmental science and nonprofit management.

She listed past employers including Sargent Camp, Newfound Memorial High School, the Montshire Museum of Science, UNH Cooperative Extension, the University of New Hampshire and the Lake Wentworth Foundation.
Burnett-Kurie advanced from the Democratic primary for Carroll 6 on September 10, 2024, but finished fourth in the two-seat general election that November with 20.0 percent of the vote.
She listed volunteer work including service as a lake steward in Wolfeboro and with the Abenaki Tower and Trail Association in Tuftonboro.
